parameters.query:
=SELECT m.id, m.title, m.summary, m.lastTimeEmailSent, u.email, u.name
FROM meetings m
JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id
WHERE m.id = '{{ $json.meetingId }}'
LIMIT 1

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ from: 'Neshastyar <noreply@neshastyar.com>', to: [$json.email], subject: 'خلاصه جلسه: ' + $json.title, html: $json.htmlBody }) }}

parameters.query: =UPDATE meetings SET lastTimeEmailSent = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $('Format Email').item.json.meetingId }}'

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { data: { success: true, message: 'Meeting summary email sent successfully', meetingId: $('Format Email').item.json.meetingId, userEmail: $('Format Email').item.json.email, emailSentAt: new Date().toISOString() }, error: null } }}

={{ { error: $('Format Email').item.json.message || 'Failed to send email', message: $('Format Email').item.json.message || 'Failed to send email', cooldownRemaining: $('Format Email').item.json.cooldownRemaining || undefined }, data: null } }}
